[[Kunan's Bastion]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[shield]] dropped by [[Kunan the Loudmouth]], a [[boss]] who can be found in the [[Wilderness of Bahdza]].

==Stats==
:[[Armor rating|Armor]]: 16 (Requires 9 [[Command]])
:Armor +10 (vs. [[Piercing damage]])
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Vabbian Bastion]], dyed a mix of black and grey.

==Replica==
Except for the visual appearance and [[armor calculation#Categories|armor category]] of the inscription, it is possible to create a replica for this item with the same stats. Inscriptions on replicas provide core armor rather than bonus armor and are not limited by the bonus armor cap.
